vsm2.14:25.1: Tatradhammaniruttābhilāpe ñāṇanti tasmiṃ atthe ca dhamme ca yā sabhāvanirutti abyabhicārī vohāro.
vsm2.14:25.2: Tadabhilāpe tassa bhāsane udīraṇe taṃ bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ udīritaṃ sutvāva ayaṃ sabhāvanirutti, ayaṃ na sabhāvaniruttīti
vsm2.14:25.3: evaṃ tassā dhammaniruttisaññitāya sabhāvaniruttiyā māgadhikāya sabbasattānaṃ mūlabhāsāya pabhedagataṃ ñāṇaṃ niruttipaṭisambhidā.
vsm2.14:25.4: Niruttipaṭisambhidāppatto hi phasso vedanāti evamādivacanaṃ sutvāva ayaṃ sabhāvaniruttīti jānāti.
vsm2.14:25.5: Phassā vedanoti evamādikaṃ pana ayaṃ na sabhāvaniruttīti.
vsm2.14:26.1: Ñāṇesuñāṇanti sabbattha ñāṇamārammaṇaṃ katvā paccavekkhantassa ñāṇārammaṇaṃ ñāṇaṃ,
vsm2.14:26.2: yathāvuttesu vā tesu ñāṇesu sagocarakiccādivasena vitthārato ñāṇaṃ paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāti attho.
vsm2.14:27.1: Catassopi cetā paṭisambhidā dvīsu ṭhānesu pabhedaṃ gacchanti sekkhabhūmiyañca asekkhabhūmiyañca.
vsm2.14:28.1: Evaṃ dvīsu bhūmīsu pabhedaṃ gacchantiyopi cetā adhigamena pariyattiyā savanena paripucchāya pubbayogena cāti imehi pañcahākārehi visadā honti.
vsm2.14:28.4: Savanaṃ nāma sakkaccaṃ atthiṃ katvā dhammassavanaṃ.
vsm2.14:28.6: pubbayogo nāma pubbabuddhānaṃ sāsane gatapaccāgatikabhāvena yāva anulomaṃ gotrabhusamīpaṃ, tāva vipassanānuyogo.
vsm2.14:30.2: Bāhusaccaṃ nāma tesu tesu satthesu ca sippāyatanesu ca kusalatā.
vsm2.14:30.5: Āgamo nāma antamaso opammavaggamattassapi buddhavacanassa pariyāpuṇanaṃ.
vsm2.14:30.7: Adhigamo nāma sotāpannatā vā…pe… arahattaṃ vā.
vsm2.14:30.8: Garusannissayo nāma sutapaṭibhānabahulānaṃ garūnaṃ santike vāso.
vsm2.14:31.1: Tattha buddhā ca paccekabuddhā ca pubbayogañceva adhigamañca nissāya paṭisambhidā pāpuṇanti.
vsm2.14:31.3: Paṭisambhidāppattiyā ca pāṭiyekko kammaṭṭhānabhāvanānuyogo nāma natthi.
vsm2.14:31.6: Tathāgatānaṃ hi dasabalāni viya ariyānaṃ ariyaphaleneva paṭisambhidā ijjhantīti
vsm2.14:31.7: imā paṭisambhidā sandhāya vuttaṃ catupaṭisambhidāvasena catubbidhāti.
vsm2.14:32.2: ettha pana yasmā imāya paññāya khandhāyatanadhātuindriyasaccapaṭiccasamuppādādibhedā dhammā bhūmi.
vsm2.14:32.3: Sīlavisuddhi ceva cittavisuddhi cāti imā dve visuddhiyo mūlaṃ.
vsm2.14:32.4: Diṭṭhivisuddhi, kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi, maggāmaggañāṇadassanavisuddhi, paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhi, ñāṇadassanavisuddhīti imā pañca visuddhiyo sarīraṃ.
vsm2.14:32.5: Tasmā tesu bhūmibhūtesu dhammesu uggahaparipucchāvasena ñāṇaparicayaṃ katvā mūlabhūtā dve visuddhiyo sampādetvā sarīrabhūtā pañca visuddhiyo sampādentena bhāvetabbā.
vsm2.14:33.2: ettha khandhāti pañca khandhā rūpakkhandho vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandhoti.
vsm2.14:34.1: Tattha yaṃ kiñci sītādīhi ruppanalakkhaṇaṃ dhammajātaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ ekato katvā rūpakkhandhoti veditabbaṃ.
vsm2.14:35.1: Tattha bhūtarūpaṃ catubbidhaṃ – pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātūti.
vsm2.14:36.1: Upādārūpaṃ catuvīsatividhaṃ – cakkhu, sotaṃ, ghānaṃ, jivhā, kāyo, rūpaṃ, saddo, gandho, raso,
vsm2.14:36.4: rūpassa lahutā, rūpassa mudutā, rūpassa kammaññatā, rūpassa upacayo, rūpassa santati, rūpassa jaratā, rūpassa aniccatā, kabaḷīkāro āhāroti.
vsm2.14:42.1: Keci pana ‘‘tejādhikānaṃ bhūtānaṃ pasādo cakkhu, vāyupathavīāpādhikānaṃ bhūtānaṃ pasādā sotaghānajivhā, kāyo sabbesampī’’ti vadanti.
vsm2.14:42.2: Apare ‘‘tejādhikānaṃ pasādo cakkhu, vivaravāyuāpapathavādhikānaṃ sotaghānajivhākāyā’’ti vadanti.
vsm2.14:43.1: Keci panettha ‘‘tejādīnaṃ guṇehi rūpādīhi anugayhabhāvato’’ti kāraṇaṃ dassenti.
vsm2.14:43.3: Avinibbhogavuttīsu hi bhūtesu ayaṃ imassa guṇo ayaṃ imassa guṇoti na labbhā vattu’’nti.
vsm2.14:44.1: Athāpi vadeyyuṃ ‘‘yathā tesu tesu sambhāresu tassa tassa bhūtassa adhikatāya pathavīādīnaṃ sandhāraṇādīni kiccāni icchatha,
vsm2.14:44.2: evaṃ tejādiadhikesu sambhāresu rūpādīnaṃ adhikabhāvadassanato icchitabbametaṃ rūpādayo tesaṃ guṇā’’ti.
vsm2.14:44.3: Te vattabbā ‘‘iccheyyāma, yadi āpādhikassa āsavassa gandhato pathavīadhike kappāse gandho adhikataro siyā,
vsm2.14:44.4: tejādhikassa ca uṇhodakassa vaṇṇato sītudakassa vaṇṇo parihāyetha’’.
vsm2.14:45.1: Yasmā panetaṃ ubhayampi natthi, tasmā pahāyetaṃ etesaṃ nissayabhūtānaṃ visesakappanaṃ,
vsm2.14:45.2: ‘‘yathā avisesepi ekakalāpe bhūtānaṃ rūparasādayo aññamaññaṃ visadisā honti, evaṃ cakkhupasādādayo avijjamānepi aññasmiṃ visesakāraṇe’’ti gahetabbametaṃ.
vsm2.14:45.3: Kiṃ pana taṃ yaṃ aññamaññassa asādhāraṇaṃ?
vsm2.14:45.5: Tasmā kammavisesato etesaṃ viseso, na bhūtavisesato.
vsm2.14:45.6: Bhūtavisese hi sati pasādova na uppajjati.
vsm2.14:46.1: Evaṃ kammavisesato visesavantesu ca etesu cakkhusotāni asampattavisayagāhakāni,
vsm2.14:46.2: attano nissayaṃ anallīnanissaye eva visaye viññāṇahetuttā.
vsm2.14:46.4: nissayavasena ceva, sayañca, attano nissayaṃ allīneyeva visaye viññāṇahetuttā.
vsm2.14:47.1: Cakkhu cettha yadetaṃ loke nīlapakhumasamākiṇṇakaṇhasukkamaṇḍalavicittaṃ nīluppaladalasannibhaṃ cakkhūti vuccati.
vsm2.14:47.2: Tassa sasambhāracakkhuno setamaṇḍalaparikkhittassa kaṇhamaṇḍalassa majjhe abhimukhe ṭhitānaṃ sarīrasaṇṭhānuppattipadese
vsm2.14:47.3: sattasu picupaṭalesu āsittatelaṃ picupaṭalāni viya satta akkhipaṭalāni byāpetvā
vsm2.14:47.4: dhāraṇanhāpanamaṇḍanabījanakiccāhi catūhi dhātīhi khattiyakumāro viya sandhāraṇabandhanaparipācanasamudīraṇakiccāhi catūhi dhātūhi katūpakāraṃ
vsm2.14:47.5: utucittāhārehi upatthambhiyamānaṃ āyunā anupāliyamānaṃ vaṇṇagandharasādīhi parivutaṃ
vsm2.14:49.1: Sasambhārasotabilassa anto tanutambalomācite aṅgulivedhakasaṇṭhāne padese sotaṃ
vsm2.14:49.3: utucittāhārehi upatthambhiyamānaṃ āyunā anupāliyamānaṃ vaṇṇādīhi parivutaṃ
vsm2.14:52.1: Yāvatā pana imasmiṃ kāye upādiṇṇarūpaṃ nāma atthi. Sabbattha kāyo kappāsapaṭale sneho viya
vsm2.14:54.1: Tato paresu pana rūpādīsu cakkhupaṭihananalakkhaṇaṃ rūpaṃ,
vsm2.14:54.6: Yattha pana viseso atthi, tattha vakkhāma.
vsm2.14:58.8: na ca kāyapasādena ṭhitokāse ṭhitanti vā aṭṭhitokāse ṭhitanti vāti vattabbataṃ āpajjati,
